notes.title: CONTINUE BUG FIX
notes.notes:
CONTINUE BUG FIX

Fixed a bug that caused the player to start at a boss when continuing instead of in the upgrade room on Page and Squire difficulties
Automatically fully power up player on death at final boss

notes.title: LOCALIZATION BUG FIX
notes.notes:
LOCALIZATION BUG FIX

Some users see an error that no translations are available. Language fallback was reimplemented and assets recompiled to address this.

notes.title: Text Bug Fix
notes.notes:
TEXT BUG FIX

A bug which prevented text from displaying properly for some players has been fixed

notes.title: TIMER UPDATE
notes.notes: Updated the formatting of the displayed time at the end of the game.

notes.title: UPDATE TO THE HERMIT AND POPO BAWA
notes.notes:
http://nebula.wsimg.com/513cebc81ffdfb0909b3234400c7841e?AccessKeyId=13E572309F80C3ED69FB&disposition=0&alloworigin=1
The Hermit was rebuilt to eliminate rare bug.
Popo Bawa was updated to remove lingering objects which could damage the player after Popo Bawa death.
Minor updates and bug fixes.

notes.title: BUER UPDATE
notes.notes: Buer updated to have more complex movement.

notes.title: VARCOLAC DESIGN UPDATE, BUG FIXES
notes.notes:
Varcolac was updated with additional attacks and refinements to the current attacks.

Various bosses were updated to respond to weapons in a consistent way.

Minor bug fixes were implemented.

notes.title: Boss Adjustment and Tutorial Update
notes.notes: All bosses adjusted to increase playability. The Tutorial was revised to provide more instruction on the Powerup System. Some weapon locations were adjusted.

notes.title: Ice Knight Update
notes.notes: Ice Knight update to improve playability. Added screen shake to Telekinesis subweapon.

notes.title: MINOR BUG FIXES
notes.notes: Minor bug fixes for full screen support and Thanatos.

notes.title: Summon Wraith weapon update.
notes.notes: Summon Wraith weapon no longer selected at the beginning of Level 3
